description: This file implements a Zephyr-based LWM2M Software Management Object, including resource definitions, instance management, event handling, and callback setup for software update procedures.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_activate_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for activating a software package instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_deactivate_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for deactivating a software package instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_install_package_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for installing a software package.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_delete_package_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for deleting a software package.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_write_package_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for writing a package.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_set_read_package_version_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback function for reading the package version.

methods.name: lwm2m_swmgmt_install_completed
methods.description: Marks the completion of a software installation, handling success or failure.
